entries.snippet: 10 pooled heads). Transcriptomics were performed at day 14, an age at which the flies showed a clear motor phenotype but before significant mortality. The effects of Wwox knockdown and Aβ42 expression could be clearly separated along PC1 and PC2, explaining 23% and 15% of variance respectively (Supplementary Fig. 4). Knockdown of Wwox in a control background significantly downregulated 54 genes and upregulated 44 (Fig. 4A, Supplementary Table 3). Overrepresentation analysis determined these genes were enriched for oxidoreductase activity and metabolism of ascorbate, aldarate, and porphyrins (Fig. 4B, Supplementary Table 3). Overexpressing human Aβ42 in neurons downregulated 23 genes and upregulated 51 (Fig. 4C, Supplementary Table 3); overrepresentation analysis revealed a significant association of these genes with fatty acid and pyruvate metabolism (Fig. 4D, Supplementary Table 3), suggesting amyloid expression induces metabolic changes. Knockdown of Wwox in neurons also overexpressing Aβ42, significantly downregulated 58 genes and upregulated 54 genes (Fig. 4E, Supplementary Table 3). These genes were enriched within pyruvate metabolism, lipid metabolism and pentose and glucuronate interconversion pathways (Fig. 4F, Supplementary Table 3), suggesting that knockdown of Wwox in the presence of Aβ42 may alter the metabolome further via transcriptional regulation.Figure 4 Neuronal Wwox knockdown in the presence of Aβ42 vastly alters the metabolic transcriptome.
